entries.name: Software localization
entries.definition: Adapting software to a specific language and region, including translating text and adjusting formats such as dates and currencies.

entries.name: Software quality assurance
entries.definition: Planning and carrying out the processes and checks that make sure software meets its quality requirements.

entries.name: Software quality management
entries.definition: Planning, controlling and improving the quality of software across its development, through standards, reviews and testing.

entries.name: Software reliability testing
entries.definition: Testing software to measure how long and how often it runs without failure under expected use.

entries.name: Software testing life cycle
entries.definition: The sequence of phases in software testing, from analysing requirements and planning through designing and running tests to closing the cycle.

entries.name: Soil fertility treatment
entries.definition: Improving the nutrient content and condition of soil, for example with fertilisers, lime or organic matter.

entries.name: Solar panel
entries.definition: A panel of photovoltaic cells that converts sunlight into electricity.

entries.name: Solar street light
entries.definition: A street lamp powered by a solar panel and battery that switches on automatically at dusk.

entries.name: SonicStage
entries.definition: Sony's music management software for ripping CDs, organising a library and transferring tracks to Sony portable players.

entries.name: SonicWall
entries.definition: A line of network security appliances and software, chiefly firewalls, from the vendor SonicWall.

entries.name: Soot blower
entries.definition: A device in a boiler that cleans soot and ash off heat-transfer surfaces with jets of steam or air.

entries.name: Source Insight
entries.definition: A source code editor and browser for large programs, from SI Software, that analyses code to show symbols and call relationships.

entries.name: SourceGear Vault
entries.definition: A centralised version control system from SourceGear.

entries.name: Sovereign cloud
entries.definition: Cloud computing arranged so that data, operations and control stay within the legal jurisdiction of a particular country or region.

entries.name: spaCy
entries.definition: An open-source Python library for natural language processing tasks such as tokenisation, part-of-speech tagging and named-entity recognition.

entries.name: Special education
entries.definition: The teaching of students whose learning needs arise from disabilities or other exceptionalities, using adapted methods and supports.

entries.name: Special education law
entries.definition: The body of law, such as the US Individuals with Disabilities Education Act, that sets the rights and services owed to students with disabilities.

entries.name: Special hazards suppression systems
entries.definition: Fire suppression systems that use gas, foam or other agents to protect high-value or high-risk areas, such as data centres and flammable-liquid stores.

entries.name: Special use airspace
entries.definition: Airspace in which flight activity is restricted or the activities of other users are limited, such as restricted, prohibited and military operations areas.

entries.name: Specimen processing
entries.definition: Receiving, labelling and preparing clinical specimens so they are ready for laboratory testing.

entries.name: Spray gun
entries.definition: A handheld tool that uses compressed air or pressure to spray paint or other liquid coatings onto a surface.

entries.name: SQL-92
entries.definition: The 1992 revision of the SQL standard, which defined entry, intermediate and full levels of the database query language.

entries.name: SQL Server Express LocalDB
entries.definition: A lightweight version of the SQL Server Express database engine for developers that starts on demand and needs no server setup.

entries.name: SQL Server Integration Services
entries.definition: Microsoft's tool in SQL Server for building data integration and extract, transform and load workflows.

entries.name: SQL tuning
entries.definition: Improving the speed and resource use of SQL queries, for example by rewriting them and adjusting indexes and statistics.

entries.name: Statistics
entries.definition: Methods for reasoning from data and uncertainty.

entries.name: STM32 Nucleo
entries.definition: A family of low-cost microcontroller development boards from STMicroelectronics built around STM32 chips.

entries.name: SWIFT network
entries.definition: Financial messaging network; not the programming language.

entries.name: Technical writing
entries.definition: Communicating technical information clearly in written form.

entries.name: TensorFlow
entries.definition: Building and executing machine-learning models with TensorFlow.

entries.name: Software testing
entries.definition: Designing checks and cases to evaluate software behavior.

entries.name: TL 9000
entries.definition: A quality management system standard for the telecommunications industry, built on ISO 9001.

entries.name: Agent tool use
entries.definition: Connecting an agent to bounded external capabilities.

entries.name: Training material development
entries.definition: Creating the guides, slides, exercises and other content used to teach people a job or a product.

entries.name: UltraTax CS
entries.definition: Thomson Reuters software that accounting firms use to prepare tax returns.

entries.name: Unisys MAPPER
entries.definition: A Unisys reporting and application development system for building database reports and applications, mainly on mainframes.
variants: MAintain Prepare And Produce Executive Reports (MAPPER)
MAintain, Prepare, And Produce Executive Reports (MAPPER)

entries.name: Usability testing
entries.definition: Evaluating how people use an interface to complete tasks.

entries.name: User experience design
entries.definition: Designing interactions around user needs and usability.

entries.name: User interface design
entries.definition: Designing the visible controls and presentation of interactive software.

entries.name: User research
entries.definition: Investigating user needs and behavior to inform design.
